# Clock Contract Checklist: Honest command clock evidence

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of clock honesty and compatibility before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-10-22
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by speckit-checklist; standard depth, reviewer/PR audience. No intent questions: coordinator specified timing/projection/compatibility scope.
**Review Ownership**: Reviewer owns checkbox state. Authorized agent artifact review replaces routine human review.
**Marker Semantics**: Checked means requirements quality reviewed and satisfied, never implementation complete.

## Completeness and clarity

- [x] CHK001 Are actual UTC endpoints distinguished from elapsed duration, including backward steps? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are opt-in basis, complete evidence, numeric bounds, finite values and consistency tolerance defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Data Model]
- [x] CHK003 Is signed discrepancy defined without claiming an absolute error estimate or exact clock-step cause? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK004 Are unavailable/partial legacy observations distinguished from malformed monotonic opt-in? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, §FR-005]

## Consistency and compatibility

- [x] CHK005 Are strict UTC-only defaults and additive V2/version limits explicit, including older-reader limits and V1 rejection? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-007]
- [x] CHK006 Are duplicated native/result observations required to agree rather than selecting an arbitrary copy? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK007 Are producer-local monotonic-domain assumptions explicit without cross-host subtraction? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK008 Are outcome, redaction, clock-estimate and validity/comparison semantics preserved across all documents? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §FR-006]

## Coverage and boundaries

- [x] CHK009 Are four returned outcomes plus forward/backward/no-step cases covered by objective acceptance criteria? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §FR-008]
- [x] CHK010 Are nonfinite/boolean/partial/reversed/inconsistent inputs and timezone/tolerance boundaries specified? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Data Model]
- [x] CHK011 Are durable round-trip/provenance and affected schema exports explicitly covered without overstating schema arithmetic checks? [Coverage, Spec §SC-003, §FR-007, Contract §Evidence limits and schema exports]
- [x] CHK012 Are ownership, merged baseline dependency and exclusions for research/cloud/sibling work declared? [Dependencies, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Interfaces and file ownership]

## Notes

Generated 12 unchecked items, then separately evaluated under the coordinator's authorized artifact-review assignment on 2026-10-22: 12/12 satisfied. CHK007 explicitly bounds clock-origin inference; no implementation completeness is implied. speckit-implement reads checklist state and must not change markers. Built-in requirements.md has its own specify/clarify lifecycle.
